adapterEnvironment: TOKENLENS_BUDGET_ADAPTER: absolute E-owned trusted module exporting async createHookDependencies() => {service,resolveScope}

SessionStart.purpose: Restore short current budget after start, resume or compaction

UserPromptSubmit.purpose: One short summary per new turn, including final reply costs from the previous turn

SubagentStart.purpose: Verified child receives the shared root budget without unrelated conversation data

PreToolUse.purpose: Only low/overspent transitions with a reminder cooldown; never blocks/replaces calls

disabledBehavior: No stdout or stderr, no additionalContext, no model invocation, no readUsage. No global rules.
limitations: Host plugin hook registration/trust and actual model delivery must be tested by E before claiming AI is informed
No guarantee of token-level real-time notification or model compliance
Local deduplicated ledger scope and descendant ownership must be supplied by A/E
No account ID is inferred from the latest account or working directory
